layers.note: Layers inside a package need every file: run `scripts/graph/` in a checkout for layers and what triggers what

fixes.text: Run only what a change can reach: no path filters or affected-only selection on PR workflows
"Spec - JRuby" runs 12 min in one job: shard it
Jobs wait 486 s for a runner at p90: GitHub-hosted runners are often slow to start, so price a faster provider
Move broad checks to a scheduled sweep

notes.text: ci-doctor's guides are strongest for TypeScript and Rust. For Ruby it applies the principles, without a Ruby-specific page
